product_overview: Finance Tracker is a multi-user expense management web app that lets teams track transactions, plan budgets, automate recurring items, and analyze spend with reports and visual KPIs. Users operate within organizations to collaborate on finances and manage access.
core_goals: Record income and expenses with category, amount, date, and description for personal or shared organizations.
Define and monitor budgets with visual health indicators and receive warnings as spending approaches limits.
Automate repeated income/expense items via recurring rules to keep cashflow up to date.
Invite and manage teammates in a shared organization context to collaborate on finance data.
Review consolidated financial KPIs, charts, recent activity, and exportable reports for decision making.

features.name: Authentication and access control
features.description: Protect organization and product pages so only authenticated users can access organization data and app pages; unauthenticated users are prompted to sign in before entering protected areas.
user_flows: Attempt to access /dashboard -> See sign-in prompt -> Submit incorrect credentials -> See validation error -> Correct credentials and submit -> Land on /dashboard
Attempt to access /transactions while unauthenticated -> See sign-in prompt -> Submit valid credentials -> Access /transactions

features.name: Dashboard monitoring
features.description: Provide organization-level financial KPIs, trend charts, alerts, and recent ledger activity so users can quickly assess financial health.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Review KPI cards for key metrics -> Inspect trend visualization for selected period -> Scan alerts and recent ledger activity

features.name: Transaction lifecycle management
features.description: Create, edit, filter and remove transactions so users can maintain an accurate ledger and find specific entries quickly.
user_flows: Navigate to /transactions -> Open new transaction form -> Enter amount -> Select category -> Set date -> Add description -> Submit transaction form -> See new transaction appear in list
Navigate to /transactions -> Filter transactions by date range -> Scan filtered list for target entry
Navigate to /transactions -> Select a transaction from list -> Open edit transaction form -> Modify amount or category -> Submit changes -> See transaction updated in list
Navigate to /transactions -> Select a transaction from list -> Initiate delete action -> Confirm deletion -> See transaction removed from list

features.name: Budget planning
features.description: Allow users to create and adjust budget allocations, track utilization visually, and remove budgets when no longer needed.
user_flows: Navigate to /budgets -> Open new budget modal -> Enter budget name -> Set budget limit and period -> Submit budget -> See budget card with utilization indicator
Navigate to /budgets -> Select a budget card -> Open edit budget modal -> Update limit or period -> Save changes -> See updated utilization reflected
Navigate to /budgets -> Select a budget card -> Initiate remove action -> Confirm removal -> See budget removed from list

features.name: Recurring transactions
features.description: Create and manage repeating income or expense rules so regular items are tracked automatically on a cadence.
user_flows: Navigate to /recurring -> Open add recurring transaction form -> Enter amount -> Choose cadence (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly) -> Set start date -> Submit rule -> See recurring entry listed
Navigate to /recurring -> Select a recurring entry -> Open edit form -> Change cadence or amount -> Save changes -> See updated rule in list
Navigate to /recurring -> Select a recurring entry -> Initiate delete action -> Confirm deletion -> See recurring entry removed

features.name: Team and organization management
features.description: Create or join organizations and invite teammates so multiple users can collaborate within shared organization contexts with role-based access.
user_flows: Navigate to /org-setup while authenticated -> Enter organization name and required details -> Submit organization creation -> Be added to organization and land on /dashboard
Navigate to /team -> Enter teammate email to invite -> Submit invitation -> See pending invitation in team list
Navigate to /team -> Review active members and pending invitations -> Revoke a pending invitation or remove a member -> See team list updated

features.name: Reports and analytics
features.description: Provide interactive charts, period comparisons, and exportable reports to help users analyze spend patterns and share insights.
user_flows: Navigate to /reports -> Select a date range and comparison period -> Review interactive charts and category breakdowns -> Inspect period-over-period comparison
Navigate to /reports -> Configure report filters -> Export report as CSV -> Download CSV file

features.name: Settings and account management
features.description: Let users manage account and organization settings, notification preferences, and perform irreversible actions from a controlled 'danger zone'.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Update account or organization details -> Save changes -> See confirmation of successful update
Navigate to /settings -> Open danger zone controls -> Initiate organization-level destructive action (user confirms intent) -> See confirmation and resulting state change
